insight: Raised a $38M Series B in 2024, co-led by Third Point Ventures and DTCP with Microsoft's M12, to secure agentic AI and low-code apps.
name: Zenity
tagline: Security and governance for AI agents and copilots.
description: Zenity is a security platform for AI agents, copilots, and low-code/no-code apps built across enterprise platforms. It discovers agents in use, applies governance and security guardrails, and continuously monitors for risks and threats — giving security teams observability and runtime protection over autonomous and business-built applications.

modelSupport.notes: Secures agents and copilots regardless of the underlying model or platform.

edge: Purpose-built for AI agents and copilots, not retrofitted app security — discovery, governance, and runtime threat protection from one console.
